name: Himachal Pradesh

topAttractions.name: Manali
topAttractions.description: A popular hill station known for its snow-capped mountains, picturesque valleys, and adventure sports like skiing and paragliding.

topAttractions.name: Shimla
topAttractions.description: The capital city of Himachal Pradesh, known for its colonial architecture, scenic views, and the famous Mall Road.

topAttractions.name: Dharamshala
topAttractions.description: A hill station and the headquarters of the Central Tibetan Administration, known for its Buddhist monasteries and the famous McLeod Ganj market.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Himachal Pradesh is from March to June and from September to November, when the weather is pleasant and ideal for sightseeing.
culturalFact: Himachal Pradesh is home to the ancient Kullu Valley Shiva temple, also known as the Bheeshma Shakthi Temple, which is a significant Shiva temple in the region.

hiddenGem.name: Solang Valley
hiddenGem.description: A picturesque valley near Manali, known for its stunning views, trekking trails, and adventure sports like paragliding and zorbing.

relatedFestival: The Himachal Pradesh government celebrates the Himachal Day on April 15th, which commemorates the state's formation in 1948.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for the Rohtang Pass, the Kullu Valley, or the Manali-Leh Highway, they will appear here! These are some of the most popular attractions in Himachal Pradesh.
